label: David Papineau, The Rise of Physicalism…: N3i, INTERACTION_NATURALISM_4: at the selected world…
locator: pp.3–12 p.11 ('physicalism is best formulated ... as the significantly weaker claim that everything that interacts causally with the physical world is physical')
interpretation: Papineau's preferred formulation at p.11. Read as N3i with P = physical: whatever causes a physical effect is physical. 'Interacts causally' is read as causing something physical; the converse direction, being affected by the physical, is not used. P is physical in his sense (DEF-PAPINEAU-PHYSICAL), not spatiotemporal.
attribution: The passage states that everything that interacts causally with the physical world is physical, which is the premise with P = physical and interaction read as causing a physical effect.
